title: Meridian Trade Holdings enters administration
author: M. Andreou
body:
Meridian Trade Holdings Ltd entered administration on 2 February 2026, according to a
filing at the British Virgin Islands registry. The administrator, Harlan Restructuring,
confirmed that trading had ceased.

The collapse follows the 2024 regulatory penalty imposed by the FCA. Creditors are expected
to recover between 20 and 30 pence in the pound according to an early estimate.
